Police made the accused march shirtless in Kolkata, and the act has drawn mixed reactions from the public. Some residents say it sends a strong message to offenders, while others question whether such public display of the accused is legal or humane before guilt is proven in court. We spoke to people on the ground to understand where Kolkata stands on the issue. Watch
